params.caption: Jazzy liquid drum and bass at 172 BPM in D Dorian. Warm Rhodes electric piano playing extended ninth and thirteenth chords, a rolling reese bass with a clean sub under it, crisp breakbeat drums with shuffled ghost-note hats and a tight snare, a soft pad and a light arpeggio shimmer. Polished studio production, wide and clean. Instrumental, no vocals.
